description: This file contains unit tests for the ModelTrait's normalization of nested collections within the OrangeHRM API v2 serialization context. It defines test cases that verify the normalization logic applied to Employee objects with hierarchical supervisor relationships, testing methods like 'normalizeNestedCollection' via reflection or invocation helpers.

classes.name: TestEmployee
classes.description: A simple employee class used as a test fixture with properties for ID, name, and supervisors, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: A class implementing the Normalizable interface, using the ModelTrait, tested for nested collection normalization.

methods.name: testCallNestedCollections
methods.description: Tests normalization of a nested collection with a single level, verifying that only IDs are extracted.

methods.name: testCallNestedCollectionsFor
methods.description: Tests normalization with multiple fields and nested objects, ensuring correct extraction of specified properties.
